request.state:
AURELLE AIR — CUSTOMER RELATIONS, COMPENSATION DESK
Claim file CR-26-08-44187. Documents: (1) Passenger Service Commitment (PSC), edition 2025, as amended by Revision 3; (2) superseded PSC Revision 2 list of extraordinary circumstances (retained in the claim template); (3) Annex D distance table extract; (4) booking and operational records; (5) claim correspondence.

(1) PASSENGER SERVICE COMMITMENT — EDITION 2025 (in force for flights from 1 April 2025), WITH REVISION 3 (in force for flights operated from 1 February 2026)

Part A — General
A1 The PSC is part of Aurelle Air's Conditions of Carriage. It gives passengers rights to care, rerouting, refunds and fixed compensation in the cases described below. It does not limit any rights passengers have under the law of the country of departure.
A2 The PSC applies to passengers holding a confirmed reservation on a flight operated by Aurelle Air, who presented themselves for check-in by the published deadline (or, with online check-in, at the gate by the boarding deadline).
A3 Codeshare flights marketed by Aurelle Air but operated by another airline are handled under the operating airline's conditions.

Part B — Definitions
B1 "Booking" — one or more flights under one booking reference (PNR), ticketed together. Flights booked under separate PNRs are separate Bookings even when the passengers travel together.
B2 "Final Destination" — the destination on the ticket of the last flight of the Booking. Alternative connecting flights taken because of a disruption do not change the Final Destination.
B3 "Arrival Time" — the moment at which at least one door of the aircraft is opened after the aircraft has reached its parking position, passengers being permitted to leave the aircraft. Touchdown time and on-block time are recorded for operational purposes and are not the Arrival Time.
B4 "Arrival Delay" — the difference between the scheduled arrival time at the Final Destination of the Booking and the Arrival Time at the Final Destination, both expressed in the same time reference.
B5 "Distance" — the great-circle distance between the airport of first departure and the Final Destination of the Booking, as listed in Annex D. For Bookings with connections, the distances of the individual flights are not added.
B6 "Extraordinary Circumstances" — the circumstances listed in Part F, which could not have been avoided even if all reasonable measures had been taken.
B7 "Rerouting" — carriage to the Final Destination under comparable conditions at the earliest opportunity, offered by Aurelle Air after a cancellation, denied boarding or missed connection.

Part C — Care
C1 Meals and refreshments in reasonable relation to the waiting time, from 2 hours of expected delay (short flights), 3 hours (medium), 4 hours (long).
C2 Hotel accommodation where an overnight stay becomes necessary.
C3 Care is provided in kind (vouchers) or reimbursed against receipts within reasonable limits.
C4 Passengers are offered two telephone calls or e-mails free of charge.
C5 Care is not refused because the cause of the delay is an Extraordinary Circumstance; E3 limits fixed compensation only.

Part D — Refunds and rerouting
D1 Where a flight is cancelled, or a delay of 5 hours or more is expected, passengers may choose a refund of the unused part of the ticket instead of travel.
D2 A passenger who misses a connection within the same Booking because of a delay of an earlier flight is offered Rerouting.

Part E — Fixed compensation
E1 A passenger whose Arrival Delay at the Final Destination is 3 hours or more receives fixed compensation according to the Distance:
  Distance up to 1,500 km: EUR 250
  Distance more than 1,500 km and up to 3,500 km: EUR 400
  Distance more than 3,500 km: EUR 300 if the Arrival Delay is 3 hours or more but less than 4 hours; EUR 600 if the Arrival Delay is 4 hours or more.
E2 Compensation under E1 is reduced by 50 % where the passenger was offered Rerouting and the Arrival Delay at the Final Destination does not exceed: 2 hours (Distance up to 1,500 km), 3 hours (more than 1,500 up to 3,500 km), 4 hours (more than 3,500 km).
E3 No compensation is payable where the delay or cancellation was caused by Extraordinary Circumstances, or where the passenger was informed of a cancellation at least 14 days before scheduled departure.
E4 Compensation is paid per passenger, in cash, bank transfer or (with the passenger's written agreement) travel vouchers. Infants travelling free of charge on a lap are not entitled to compensation.
E5 Where a delay on an earlier flight of the Booking causes a missed connection, the Arrival Delay at the Final Destination is decisive; the cause of the delay of the earlier flight is examined under E3.
E6 Claims must be made within 2 years of the scheduled date of the flight.

Part F — Extraordinary Circumstances (as amended by Revision 3)
F1 Meteorological conditions incompatible with the safe operation of the flight.
F2 Air traffic management decisions (slot restrictions, airspace closures) and strikes by staff not employed by Aurelle Air or its contractors.
F3 Security risks, political instability, and airport closures ordered by authorities.
F4 Bird strikes and damage to the aircraft caused by third parties (e.g. ground-handling vehicles of other operators).
F5 Hidden manufacturing defects that affect the safety of the flight and that the aircraft manufacturer or an authority has notified to operators.
F6 Revision 3 note: technical problems that arise in connection with the maintenance or operation of the aircraft, including those discovered during routine checks or pre-flight inspections, are not Extraordinary Circumstances unless covered by F5. Staff shortages and strikes by Aurelle Air's own staff are not Extraordinary Circumstances.

Part G — Downgrading
G1 Passengers placed in a lower class than booked receive a refund of 30 % (up to 1,500 km), 50 % (1,500–3,500 km) or 75 % (above 3,500 km) of the ticket price of the affected flight.

Part H — Baggage
H1 Delayed checked baggage: reimbursement of reasonable essential purchases up to EUR 50 per day for up to 5 days, against receipts.
H2 Lost baggage: liability as set out in the Conditions of Carriage, Article 17; claims within 21 days of the date the baggage should have been delivered.
H3 Baggage delays do not give rise to fixed compensation under Part E.

Part I — Claims handling
I1 Claims are assessed per passenger. A claim form may cover several passengers of one Booking; passengers on other Bookings must claim separately.
I2 The desk establishes the facts from the operational log (times in UTC) and converts them to the local time of the relevant airport using the time references in Annex D.
I3 The automatic pre-fill in the claim template is an aid for the desk and is not binding.
I4 Payment is made within 30 days of acceptance of the claim.
I5 Travel agencies may submit claims on behalf of passengers with a signed mandate; payment is then made to the passenger's account unless the mandate says otherwise.

Part J — Passengers with reduced mobility and unaccompanied minors
J1 Passengers with reduced mobility and their companions, and unaccompanied minors, receive care under Part C as soon as possible irrespective of the delay thresholds.
J2 Compensation under Part E is not increased for these passengers.

Part K — Goodwill gestures
K1 Customer Relations may offer vouchers as a goodwill gesture where no compensation is due. Goodwill vouchers are not compensation under Part E and are not offset against it.
K2 Where compensation under Part E is paid, meal vouchers and hotel costs under Part C are not deducted.
K3 Where a passenger accepts a voucher under E4 instead of cash, the voucher value is 130 % of the cash amount.

(2) SUPERSEDED — PSC REVISION 2, PART F (flights operated 1 April 2025 – 31 January 2026), as printed in the claim template
"F1 Weather. F2 ATC decisions and strikes. F3 Security and airport closures. F4 Bird strikes. F5 Unexpected technical defects, including defects discovered during pre-flight inspection, where the aircraft had been maintained in accordance with the approved maintenance programme."

(3) ANNEX D — DISTANCE TABLE (EXTRACT), great-circle, km
Portavela (PVL) – Dornstadt (DRN) ........ 1,960
Dornstadt (DRN) – Kaarmo (KRM) ........... 1,610
Portavela (PVL) – Kaarmo (KRM) ........... 3,440
Portavela (PVL) – Kaarmo Vesijärvi (KVJ) . 3,515   (secondary airport of Kaarmo)
Portavela (PVL) – Lindholm (LDH) ......... 2,280
Lindholm (LDH) – Kaarmo (KRM) ............ 1,390
Time references: Portavela local = UTC+1; Dornstadt local = UTC+2; Kaarmo local = UTC+3 (all summer time in August 2026).

(4) BOOKING AND OPERATIONAL RECORDS
Booking PNR 7QK4ZD, ticketed 2 June 2026, passenger SAARINEN/ELENA MS, adult:
  AU 311  PVL 11:45 → DRN 16:05 (local times), 14 August 2026
  AU 874  DRN 17:05 → KRM 21:10 (local times), 14 August 2026 (scheduled connection 60 minutes)
Booking PNR 7QL0BA, ticketed 3 June 2026, passenger SAARINEN/JUHANI MR, adult, same flights and dates (booked separately by the same travel agency).
Check-in: both passengers checked in online on 13 August and were at the PVL gate before the boarding deadline.

Flight AU 311, 14 August 2026, aircraft registration EC-AUR:
  Pre-flight inspection by Aurelle Air engineers at PVL found a hydraulic fluid leak at the left main landing-gear actuator; a seal was replaced. No manufacturer or authority notice applied to the part. Departure 12:57 local (72 minutes late); arrival DRN 17:14 local (69 minutes late).
  Ground handling at PVL was provided by Portavela Ground Services, whose staff were not on strike. The PVL tower reported no slot restrictions for AU 311.
Technical log extract, EC-AUR, 14 August 2026, PVL: "Pre-flight walk-around 10:52L: fluid trace L MLG actuator. Seal P/N 42-7719-03 replaced from station stock. Leak check satisfactory 12:31L. Last A-check 2 August 2026, no findings. No airworthiness directive or service bulletin applicable to P/N 42-7719-03." Crew report AU 878 (captain): "Door 1L opened after jet-bridge docking; slight delay of jet-bridge operator." KRM station report: "AU 878 on stand 14; jet-bridge docked 21:13Z."
Missed connection: AU 874 departed DRN 17:08 local without the two passengers.
Rerouting: at the DRN transfer desk both passengers were offered AU 878 DRN 19:55 → KRM 23:55 local. Elena Saarinen accepted AU 878 (rebooked under PNR 7QK4ZD). Juhani Saarinen declined and instead accepted an offer on AU 1402 DRN 18:20 → LDH 20:05 and a connecting flight of a partner airline LDH 21:10 → KRM 23:50 local (the latter rebooked on a new PNR 7QM9XX by the transfer desk).
Flight AU 878, 14 August 2026, operational log (UTC): off-block 17:02Z; take-off 17:14Z; touchdown KRM 21:06Z; on-block 21:09Z; forward left door opened, passengers released 21:14Z.
Partner flight LDH–KRM, 14 August 2026: arrived at the gate KRM 23:40 local; door opened 23:43 local.
Care: meal vouchers EUR 15 each issued at DRN.

Earlier claims on file for the name SAARINEN/ELENA:
  CR-25-11-20931 — AU 522 KRM → PVL, 2 November 2025, Arrival Delay 3 h 41 min, cause: ATC slot restriction at KRM (Revision 2 F2); rejected under E3; not appealed.
  CR-24-06-10077 — SAARINEN/ELENA MRS, frequent-flyer no. AU 4410-2281 (different date of birth), AU 305 PVL → DRN, 6 June 2024, Arrival Delay 3 h 22 min, cause: crew shortage; paid EUR 400.
Fare paid, PNR 7QK4ZD: EUR 486.40 (economy class, both flights). No downgrade occurred.

(5) CLAIM CORRESPONDENCE
18 August 2026, online claim form, PNR 7QK4ZD, claimant Elena Saarinen: "Our first flight was late because of a technical problem, I missed my connection and arrived in Kaarmo after midnight. Please pay the compensation due under your PSC." Bank details provided.
18 August 2026, online claim form, PNR 7QL0BA, claimant Juhani Saarinen: "Same as my wife's claim."
Desk template pre-fill (automatic, based on the operational database): "AU 878 on-block 21:09Z; scheduled arrival AU 874 21:10 local; delay category: under 3 h. Cause code of AU 311: TECH-HYD. Template check box 'Extraordinary circumstances (PSC Part F5)': suggested YES."

decision.instructions: What fixed compensation does Aurelle Air owe Elena Saarinen (PNR 7QK4ZD) under the PSC?
